airframe.source: DJI Matrice 350 RTK specifications (weight with two batteries about 6.47 kg; 2.7 kg maximum payload)

power_coefficients.model: P(m) = a + b*m in W, m = airframe + onboard payload in kg; same for all three airspeeds
power_coefficients.derivation: Matrice 350 RTK: two 263.2 Wh batteries, 55 min without payload -> about 574 W at 6.47 kg; scaled with mass^1.5 and fitted by a line over 6.5-9.0 kg (decided 5 November, Q12)
power_coefficients.check: about 578 W at 6.5 kg, about 942 W at 9.0 kg; positive over the whole mass range
power_coefficients.service: service of 60 s at P(mass on arrival); service_energy_wh = 0
power_coefficients.source: DJI Matrice 350 RTK specifications; mass scaling following Dorling et al., doi 10.1109/TSMC.2016.2582745
